offering_description.value: Designs and sells premium women's and men's apparel, knitwear, footwear and accessories under the Vince brand. It sells to consumers through its own stores and website and to department and specialty stores wholesale, with products made by outside manufacturers.

primary_products.value: apparel; knitwear; footwear; handbags and accessories

customer_segment.value: B2C: affluent individual consumers buying fashion apparel and accessories; B2B: department stores and specialty fashion retailers buying wholesale

end_markets.value: fashion retail; luxury apparel; footwear and accessories

revenue_model.value: product sales: apparel, footwear and accessories sold through own stores, online and wholesale accounts; licensing or royalties: royalties from licensed product categories made by partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets the Vince brand, with products made by outside manufacturers; retailer: sells directly to consumers through own stores and e-commerce site

geography_served.value: North America: US and Canada stores, wholesale accounts and online sales

specialization.value: related lines: apparel, footwear and handbags and accessories sold under one brand

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated full-price stores and outlets; online: company e-commerce website; partners / resellers: department and specialty stores buying wholesale

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal consumer product rules such as textile labeling and product safety standards
